convert_marian_model_to_pytorch: convert a Marian MT model from marian checkpoint format to a Hugging Face PyTorch MarianMTModel
find_pretrained_translation_model: find a pretrained Helsinki-NLP opus-mt translation model for a given source and target language pair
write_marian_model_card: write a Hugging Face model card with metadata and readme from an OPUS-MT model directory
convert_all_sentencepiece_models: convert all sentencepiece-based OPUS-MT models from a registry directory to Hugging Face format
load_opus_state_dict: load an OPUS-MT model state dictionary and configuration to inspect weights and create a MarianConfig
